name: fix-regeneration-timing-after-release
body: `requirements.requirement.code-writer-worktree-only-writes` and note (6) of `requirements.note.worktree-write-scope-decisions` state the regeneration order for the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**`: after this change is released, install the released binary, run `apg init`, restart opencode, then dispatch the agent-builder on main. The corrected agent-builder template is product source embedded through `include_str!`, so it reaches `~/.opencode/agents/` once a released binary containing it is installed and `apg init` is re-run, per `AGENTS.md`'s installed-binary contract. `solution.note.worktree-write-scope-owners`, `global.constraint.worktree-isolation`, `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt`, the fs components, `global.note.fix-worktree-isolation-carve-out-count`, and `domain.note.fix-main-integration-scope-and-parent` state the release-timing order.
